meta.title: Don't Know Your Birth Time? Birth Time Rectification
meta.description: Missing your birth time or date? Our Jyotish works out your accurate birth time from key life events. Fill in the questionnaire and book a 90-minute consultation.

hero.title: Don't know your birth time?
hero.lead: Many people don't know their exact birth time — it's completely normal. Using the key events of your life, our Jyotish helps find your accurate time of birth.

steps.title: Three simple
steps.s1Body: Share your birth date, an approximate time and 3–6 key life events with dates.
steps.s2Body: We scan your time window minute by minute and match ascendant and dasha changes against your events.
steps.s3Body: In a 90-minute session the Jyotish explains your rectified birth time and what it means for you.

form.title: Birth time questionnaire
form.lead: The more accurate your details, the better the result. Your information stays private.
form.modeKnown: I know my birth date, not the time
form.modeKnownSub: We'll work it out from your life events
form.modeUnknown: I don't know the date or the time
form.windowHint: Ask your family — even "early morning" or "at night" helps a lot.
form.eventsLead: At least 3 and up to 6 events — the more exact the dates, the better the result.
form.eventsLeadOptional: If you remember some key events, add them with dates (optional).
form.prashnaBody: When even the birth date is unknown, the Jyotish casts a Prashna (question) chart for the moment and place you ask. That's why we record the time as soon as you submit.
form.prashnaAsk: Would you share your current location? It makes the Prashna chart more precise. This is entirely optional.
form.geoDenied: No problem — we can go ahead without your location.
form.geoUnavailable: Your browser couldn't share a location — that's fine.
form.name: Full name
form.consent: I agree that my details are used only for this consultation (privacy policy).
form.after: Our Jyotish will contact you — the result is shared during your consultation.
